open_experiments.summary: roll-plan.ts's buildRollChild mutates the CALLER's in-memory rollBook (splice parent, push child) during PLAN-BUILDING, before syncSwingManagement's immediately-following runRoll (the actual closeAndRollSwingPosition DB write) confirms success. If that write later fails for this row (child insert throws, grade race), the parent stays OPEN in the DB but rollBook already reflects the swap for the REST of this same batch pass -- a later row's budget/cap gate could be evaluated against phantom freed/added capital. Rare trigger (DB write failure, not routine partial data), self-heals next 15-min cron tick (openRows re-fetched fresh), and mirrors an already-accepted tradeoff in commit.ts's own runningBook (mutated during planning, before executeSwingCommits' separate insert pass confirms each write) -- same repo, same pattern, not previously flagged as a bug there either. Not filing a fix: thin real-world impact vs. commit.ts's own established precedent for this shape. Revisit if a live repro ever surfaces (a roll that failed mid-batch with evidence a later same-pass candidate was mis-gated as a result).
